findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_my_profile, get_provider_details, get_provider_reviews, find_plumber, book_plumber · Private data: search_providers, get_provider_details, get_provider_reviews, create_booking, book_same_pro_again, find_handyman, book_handyman, find_hvac, book_hvac, find_plumber, book_plumber, find_electrician, book_electrician, find_renovation, book_renovation · Public sink: search_providers, get_provider_details, get_provider_reviews, create_booking, book_same_pro_again, find_handyman, book_handyman, find_hvac, book_hvac, find_plumber, book_plumber, find_electrician, book_electrician, find_renovation, book_renovation.
